title: SWAMP FUNK asset provenance manifest
description: art/manifest.json holds one row per produced asset (raw vendor output, derived file or shipped file). The licence-audit CI check validates the file against this schema. It also checks that every licenseId exists in licenses/allowlist.json, is absent from licenses/denylist.json and, for shipped rows, has clearance 'cleared'. Rows are append-only: a re-generation adds a new row with a new id and points 'parents' at the inputs it used. See docs/PIPELINE.md and docs/STACK.md.

generatedBy.description: Tool that last wrote the file, e.g. 'tools/validate-asset.ts'.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the file this row describes (art/_raw/..., art/source/..., build/..., public/assets/...).

shipped.description: True when the file (or a direct derivative) goes into public/assets.

route.description: How the asset was produced. Higgsfield rows keep the MCP/CLI distinction because their model ids differ.

vendor.description: Company or project, e.g. 'Google Cloud', 'Higgsfield', 'Esoteric Software', 'self' for owned code, 'human' for manual work.

model.description: Exact wire id as sent, e.g. 'gemini-3-pro-image', 'nano_banana_2' (Higgsfield CLI id for Nano Banana Pro), 'eleven_text_to_sound_v2', 'blender-5.2.2', 'spine-4.3.23'.

version.description: Model or tool version/date pin, e.g. CLI version, LoRA id, checkpoint hash, or 'n/a' for humans.

seed.description: Seed when the API exposes one; null when it does not (Higgsfield and Nano Banana image/video jobs have no seed).

jobId.description: Vendor job/request id (e.g. Higgsfield job_id from --json output).

promptHash.description: sha256 of the exact rendered prompt text (UTF-8, no trailing newline). null for non-prompted steps.

refHashes.description: sha256 of every reference/input image, in the order sent. Empty array when none.

parents.description: Row ids this asset was derived from (e.g. a matte's parent is the raw generation).

planTier.description: Account plan when generated, e.g. 'Scenario Pro', 'Higgsfield Ultra', 'Vertex pay-as-you-go', 'ElevenLabs Enterprise'.

tosVersion.description: Archived ToS in force, as a repo path: licenses/tos/<vendor>/<yyyy-mm-dd>.pdf.

licenseId.description: Must equal an 'id' in licenses/allowlist.json (e.g. 'vertex-nano-banana-pro', 'higgsfield', 'blender-5.2'). Enforced by licence-audit, not by this schema.

humanEditor.description: Name/handle of the human who painted over, edited, rigged or approved this asset; null for purely machine rows. This record supports copyright authorship.

humanEditSummary.description: What the human changed (e.g. 'paintover: redrew claws, fixed outline weight, recoloured belly').

approvedBy.description: Who signed off (batch sign-off, clip sign-off).

qa.description: Automated gate results that let this row through (see docs/ART_BIBLE.md#10-qa-gates).

report.description: Path to the gate report, e.g. qa/<asset>/gates.json.
